landing.tagline: A place for musicians and creatives who care about music. No clout. No pressure. Just connection, collaboration, and conversation.
landing.invitedHint: You're invited — take your time reading below, then enter when you're ready.
landing.invitedSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
landing.noRush: if you already have an account. No rush.
landing.whyBody: Most platforms weren't built for musicians to find each other. They were built for attention. Angel Island exists so creatives can meet, learn, collaborate, and grow — without algorithms, competition, or noise.
landing.what3: Join spaces to jam, collaborate, or learn
landing.what4: Ask real questions and get thoughtful answers
landing.what5: Make things with people who actually care
landing.whatClosing: Nothing to perform. Nothing to win. Just people and music.
landing.whoBody1: Beginners. Amateurs. Serious artists. Producers and engineers. Quiet and neurodivergent creatives. Anyone who wants to grow through music.
landing.whoBody2: If you care about music and want to get better, you belong here.
landing.howBody: You don't have to talk to anyone to belong. Explore quietly. Engage when you're ready. Connection happens by choice, not pressure.
landing.closing1: You don't need to be perfect. You don't need to be loud.
